definition: A body temperature higher than normal, usually a sign that the body is fighting an infection.
exampleSentence: Have you had a fever in the last 24 hours?

definition: An uneasy feeling in the stomach that often comes before vomiting.
exampleSentence: Are you feeling any nausea after eating?

definition: A feeling of being unsteady, light-headed, or like the room is spinning.
exampleSentence: Do you feel dizziness when you stand up quickly?

definition: Difficulty breathing normally, or a feeling that you can't get enough air.
exampleSentence: Tell me if you feel shortness of breath while walking.

definition: Any pain, pressure, or tightness felt in the chest area.
exampleSentence: Can you point to where the chest pain is located?

definition: A deep tiredness or lack of energy that doesn't improve with rest.
exampleSentence: How long have you been experiencing this fatigue?

definition: A feeling of coldness with shivering, often happening along with a fever.
exampleSentence: Did you have chills before the fever started?

definition: A part of the body becoming larger than usual, often due to fluid or inflammation.
exampleSentence: I noticed some swelling in your ankle.

definition: A change in the skin's color or texture, such as redness, bumps, or itching.
exampleSentence: When did you first notice the rash on your arm?

definition: A condition where the body has trouble controlling the amount of sugar in the blood.
exampleSentence: Your blood test shows signs of diabetes, so we'll check your blood sugar regularly.

definition: High blood pressure — the force of blood against your artery walls is higher than it should be.
exampleSentence: Your hypertension means we need to monitor your blood pressure at home.

definition: A condition that narrows and inflames the airways, making it harder to breathe.
exampleSentence: Your asthma may be triggered by cold air or exercise.

definition: A condition where the blood doesn't have enough healthy red blood cells to carry oxygen well.
exampleSentence: Your anemia is why you've been feeling so tired.

definition: An infection that inflames the air sacs in one or both lungs, which may fill with fluid.
exampleSentence: The X-ray confirms you have pneumonia in your right lung.

definition: A strong headache, often on one side of the head, sometimes with nausea or sensitivity to light.
exampleSentence: How often do you get these migraines each month?

definition: Swelling and tenderness of one or more joints, causing pain and stiffness.
exampleSentence: Your arthritis is likely why your knees feel stiff in the morning.

definition: A medical condition causing persistent sadness and loss of interest that affects daily life.
exampleSentence: It's common to experience depression after an illness like this — we can help.

definition: A sudden interruption of blood flow to the brain, which can damage brain tissue quickly.
exampleSentence: We need to act fast because these symptoms could mean a stroke.

definition: The area of the body between the chest and the hips, containing the stomach and intestines.
exampleSentence: I'm going to press gently on your abdomen — tell me if it hurts.

definition: The front part of the body between the neck and the abdomen, containing the heart and lungs.
exampleSentence: Please take a deep breath while I listen to your chest.

definition: The passage at the back of the mouth leading to the esophagus and windpipe.
exampleSentence: Open wide so I can take a look at your throat.

definition: The area of the spine below the ribs and above the hips.
exampleSentence: Point to where in your lower back the pain is worst.

definition: The joint connecting the hand to the forearm.
exampleSentence: Can you rotate your wrist for me slowly?

definition: The joint connecting the foot to the leg.
exampleSentence: I need to check if your ankle can bear weight.

definition: Air-filled spaces behind the forehead, cheeks, and nose that can become blocked or inflamed.
exampleSentence: Your sinuses look inflamed, which is causing the pressure in your face.

definition: The column of bones running down the back that protects the spinal cord.
exampleSentence: The scan will show us the alignment of your spine.

definition: A quick imaging test that uses a small amount of radiation to take pictures of bones and organs.
exampleSentence: We're going to take an X-ray of your chest to check your lungs.

definition: Taking a small sample of blood from a vein, usually in the arm, to test in a lab.
exampleSentence: You'll feel a quick pinch during the blood draw.

definition: Removing a small piece of tissue to examine it closely under a microscope.
exampleSentence: The biopsy will tell us exactly what kind of tissue this is.

definition: A detailed imaging test that uses magnets and radio waves instead of radiation.
exampleSentence: The MRI scan will take about 30 minutes, and you'll need to stay still.

definition: An imaging test that uses sound waves to create pictures of organs or tissues.
exampleSentence: We'll use an ultrasound to get a better look at your abdomen.

definition: A quick, painless test that records the electrical activity of the heart.
exampleSentence: We're going to place some small sensors on your chest for the EKG.

definition: Placing a thin, flexible tube into the body, often to drain urine or deliver medication.
exampleSentence: You may feel some pressure during the catheter insertion, but it shouldn't hurt.

definition: An injection that helps the body build protection against a specific disease.
exampleSentence: It's time for your annual flu vaccination.

definition: A medicine that treats infections caused by bacteria.
exampleSentence: This antibiotic will help clear up the infection in a few days.

definition: A medicine used to reduce or relieve pain.
exampleSentence: Take this painkiller every six hours if the pain returns.

definition: A medicine that reduces allergy symptoms like itching, sneezing, or a runny nose.
exampleSentence: An antihistamine should help with your allergy symptoms.

definition: A medicine that helps the body control blood sugar levels, often used to treat diabetes.
exampleSentence: I'll show you how to give yourself the insulin injection.

definition: A small device that delivers medicine directly into the lungs to help with breathing.
exampleSentence: Use your inhaler if you start to feel short of breath.

definition: A medicine that helps prevent harmful blood clots from forming.
exampleSentence: This anticoagulant will help prevent blood clots, so watch for unusual bruising.

definition: A medicine that helps manage symptoms of depression or anxiety.
exampleSentence: It may take a few weeks for the antidepressant to start working.

definition: A medicine that helps you feel calm or fall asleep, often used before a procedure.
exampleSentence: We'll give you a mild sedative before the procedure to help you relax.

definition: Do not eat or drink anything for a set period of time, usually before a test or procedure.
exampleSentence: Please don't eat or drink anything after midnight before your procedure.

definition: Keep the injured area still and raised above heart level to reduce swelling.
exampleSentence: Rest and elevate your ankle whenever you're sitting down.

definition: Put a cold pack or ice wrapped in cloth on an area to reduce swelling and pain.
exampleSentence: Apply ice to the area for 20 minutes, a few times a day.

definition: Finish all of the prescribed medicine, even after you start feeling better.
exampleSentence: It's important to complete the full course of antibiotics, even if you feel fine.

definition: Do not drink alcohol, usually because it may interact with a medicine or condition.
exampleSentence: Please avoid alcohol while you're taking this medication.

definition: Come back for another appointment about two weeks from now to check your progress.
exampleSentence: Please schedule a follow-up in two weeks so we can check your progress.

definition: Drink enough water throughout the day to support your body's recovery.
exampleSentence: Make sure to stay hydrated, especially while you're recovering.

term: Do Not Drive After Taking This
definition: This medicine can make you drowsy, so it isn't safe to drive after taking it.
exampleSentence: Do not drive after taking this medication — arrange a ride home.
